headerDisplay: Adds exactly one accessory to HomeKit for Tado presence: a simple switch. On = Tado Home mode (presence locked to Home); Off = Tado Away mode (presence locked to Away). A switch, not a security system, so HomeKit automations such as 'when the last person leaves' run without asking for confirmation. On the first start the plugin prints a Tado sign-in link to the Homebridge log; open it in a browser and approve. The session is stored and renewed automatically.
footerDisplay: The control sets Tado's presence lock, the same Home/Away switch as in the Tado app. It is not an alarm.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the control in HomeKit.

homeName.title: Tado Home Name
homeName.description: The name of the Tado home, exactly as in the Tado app. Optional: if empty, the first home of the account is used.

pollSeconds.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the current Home/Away state is read from Tado, so changes made in the Tado app show up in HomeKit.
